name: Underworld Detective
source:
Play as Mr. Sol, a detective-in-training, taking the lead on your first murder case! 

Prove your mentor, Detective Rott, that you have what it takes to become a real detective.

[From [url=https://crow-64.itch.io/underworld-detective]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演索尔先生，一名实习侦探，带头侦破你的第一起谋杀案！

向你的导师罗特侦探证明，你具备成为一名真正侦探的能力。

[来自[url=https://crow-64.itch.io/underworld-detective]itch.io[/url]]
